markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (55%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged reliability [F6] and split probabilities [F1] warrant deferring margins [F7] for recut and deeper levels.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 55%, Normal 43%, Benign 2%, Invasive 0% | Split InSitu vs Normal |
| Conformal set | {Normal, InSitu} (90% coverage) | Normal vs InSitu unseparated |
| Reliability / OOD | 33% (flagged), OOD 78% | Suspect frozen-section input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (top classes differ) | Foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 InSitu (5/5 Normal, 85–88%) [F5] | Nearest neighbors Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 4, 6, 11) · ↓ invasive · Score -1.81 [F2], 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 8, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · Score +1.45 [F3], 19/20 spot-check, 0% invasive risk · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 6, 7, 9) · ↓ invasive · Score -0.68 [F4], 20/20 AI spot-check · Validated
- **HoVer-Net nuclei** (regions 1, 8, 9) · context · 5 neoplastic in 1; 0 in 8, 9 (insufficient) · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 risk deletion beats random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197; faithful).
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI spans zero (-0.0088 to 0.0064; unverified); normal_lobules is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is Normal (43% probability, in conformal set, 5/5 similar cases Normal).
- Frozen-section quality (33% reliability, 78% OOD) or sampling obscures lesions; recut and deeper levels drafted.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 1**: Highest risk (16%), 5 neoplastic nuclei; check ducts near superior margin (93%).
2. **Regions 8, 9, 11**: Top validated invasion score (+1.45), but 0 neoplastic nuclei in 8, 9.
3. **Regions 4, 6, 7**: Check benign stroma/fat (6, 7) and lobules in 4, 6 (unreliable normal_lobules).
